description: The RouteManager class manages route collection for the OrangeHRM application, loading route configurations from YAML files within plugins using Symfony components.

classes.name: RouteManager
classes.description: Provides static methods to retrieve and cache route collections from plugin-defined YAML configuration files.

methods.name: getRoutes
methods.description: Loads and returns the RouteCollection, caching it for subsequent calls. Loads route definitions from plugin YAML files if not already loaded.
